definitions.gloss: deposit interest rate; rate paid on savings
definitions.explanation: The rate of interest a bank pays on money held in deposit accounts, expressed as an annual percentage. A standard term in personal finance and banking.

examples.japanese: {預金利率|よきんりりつ}が{下|さ}がる。
examples.english: for the deposit interest rate to fall.

examples.japanese: この{銀行|ぎんこう}は{預金利率|よきんりりつ}が{高|たか}い。
examples.english: This bank offers a high deposit interest rate.

examples.japanese: {長|なが}く{続|つづ}く{低金利|ていきんり}で、{預金利率|よきんりりつ}はほとんどゼロに{近|ちか}い。
examples.english: After a long stretch of low interest rates, the deposit rate is almost zero.

notes:
The rate earned by the depositor; set low in Japan during long periods of low interest rates.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {預金利率|よきんりりつ}を{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げる: to raise the deposit rate
- {預金利率|よきんりりつ}を{比較|ひかく}する: to compare deposit rates
- {高|たか}い{預金利率|よきんりりつ}: a high deposit rate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {金利|きんり}: interest rate — the broad term, covering both deposits and loans
- {貸出金利|かしだしきんり}: lending rate — the rate a bank charges on loans, not pays on deposits
